mapper.select: SELECT STEP_NAME, STATUS, READ_COUNT, WRITE_COUNT, FILTER_COUNT, COMMIT_COUNT FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION WHERE JOB_EXECUTION_ID = #{jobExecutionId} ORDER BY STEP_EXECUTION_ID
SELECT PARAMETER_NAME || '=' || PARAMETER_VALUE FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS WHERE JOB_EXECUTION_ID = #{jobExecutionId} AND IDENTIFYING = 'Y' ORDER BY PARAMETER_NAME
SELECT DISTINCT INSR_CLS_CD FROM TB_CTR_LGD WHERE CTR_STAT_CD IN ('20', '30') ORDER BY INSR_CLS_CD
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_RSV_CLOSE_DTL WHERE CLOSE_DT = #{closeDt} AND INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd}
DELETE FROM TB_RSV_CLOSE WHERE CLOSE_DT = #{closeDt} AND INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RSV_CLOSE (CLOSE_DT, INSR_CLS_CD, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_COUNT, PAID_AMT, CASE_RSV, IBNR_CL, IBNR_BF, IBNR_AMT, TOTAL_RSV, ELR, TAIL_FACTOR, JOB_EXECUTION_ID, CLOSE_TM, CLOSE_EMP_ID) VALUES (#{closeDt}, #{insrClsCd}, #{r.periodType}, #{periodCount}, #{r.total.paid}, #{r.total.caseReserve}, #{r.total.clIbnr}, #{r.total.bfIbnr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.total.ibnr}, #{r.total.reserve}, #{r.expectedLossRatio, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.tailFactor}, #{jobExecutionId}, #{now}, #{empId})

INSERT INTO TB_RSV_CLOSE_DTL (CLOSE_DT, INSR_CLS_CD, ACDT_PERIOD, PERIOD_FROM, PERIOD_TO, AGE, EARNED_PREM, PAID_AMT, CASE_RSV, CDF, CL_ULT, BF_ULT, METHOD, IBNR_AMT) VALUES (#{closeDt}, #{insrClsCd}, #{p.period}, #{p.periodFrom}, #{p.periodTo}, #{p.age}, #{p.earnedPremium}, #{p.paid}, #{p.caseReserve}, #{p.cdf}, #{p.clUltimate}, #{p.bfUltimate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{p.method}, #{p.ibnr})
mapper.select:
SELECT CLOSE_DT, INSR_CLS_CD, PAID_AMT, CASE_RSV, IBNR_CL, IBNR_BF, IBNR_AMT, TOTAL_RSV, ELR, JOB_EXECUTION_ID, CLOSE_TM, CLOSE_EMP_ID FROM TB_RSV_CLOSE
WHERE CLOSE_DT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CLOSE_DT FROM TB_RSV_CLOSE ORDER BY CLOSE_DT DESC LIMIT 8)
WHERE CLOSE_DT = #{closeDt}
ORDER BY CLOSE_DT DESC, INSR_CLS_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PAY_RECON_BANK (RECON_DT, TRACE_NO, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_MASK, AMOUNT, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{reconDt}, #{traceNo}, #{bankCd}, #{accountMask}, #{amount}, #{procDt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(P.TRACE_NO, B.TRACE_NO) AS TRACE_NO, P.PAYOUT_ID, P.STAT_CD AS OUR_STAT, P.PAY_AMT AS OUR_AMT, B.AMOUNT AS BANK_AMT FROM (SELECT * FROM TB_PAY_OUT WHERE (SENT_DT >= #{dayStart} AND SENT_DT < #{dayEnd}) OR TRACE_NO IN (SELECT TRACE_NO FROM TB_PAY_RECON_BANK WHERE RECON_DT = #{reconDt})) P FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM TB_PAY_RECON_BANK WHERE RECON_DT = #{reconDt}) B ON B.TRACE_NO = P.TRACE_NO ORDER BY 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PAY_RECON (RECON_DT, TRACE_NO, PAYOUT_ID, RESULT_CD, OUR_STAT_CD, OUR_AMT, BANK_AMT, JOB_EXECUTION_ID, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{reconDt}, #{r.traceNo}, #{r.payoutId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{r.result}, #{r.ourStat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.ourAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r.bankAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{jobExecutionId}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT R.RECON_DT, R.TRACE_NO, R.PAYOUT_ID, R.RESULT_CD, R.OUR_STAT_CD, R.OUR_AMT, R.BANK_AMT, P.SRC_TYPE, P.SRC_NO, R.JOB_EXECUTION_ID FROM TB_PAY_RECON R LEFT JOIN TB_PAY_OUT P ON P.PAYOUT_ID = R.PAYOUT_ID WHERE R.RECON_DT = #{reconDt} AND R.RESULT_CD <> 'MATCHED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN R.RESULT_CD = 'MATCHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, R.TRACE_NO
